ambiguities.text: The repository README warns against public internet exposure but does not specify which specific endpoints are most vulnerable to DoS attacks.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume endpoints that trigger heavy computation (e.g., state queries, validator duties) or return large responses (e.g., full beacon state) are the primary DoS vectors.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define authentication or authorization mechanisms; it only mentions 'additional security layers' should be used.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume authentication is entirely out of scope for the API spec and is expected to be implemented at the infrastructure level (reverse proxy, firewall rules, etc.).

implicit_assumptions.description: Node operators are assumed to deploy the beacon API behind appropriate security layers (reverse proxy, firewall) when exposed to untrusted networks.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: The API contains multiple endpoints that could be exploited for denial-of-service attacks, potentially disrupting validator operations and consensus participation.

implicit_assumptions.description: API clients (especially validator clients) are assumed to be trusted local processes communicating over localhost or a secure network.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious API client could manipulate validator behavior by sending crafted requests, potentially causing slashing or missed attestations.
